origine_fr: En bas, 辶, la marche ; dessus, 束, qui donnait le son mais se lit shù. C'est la marche rapide. C'est vite, la vitesse.
origine_en: Below, 辶, walking; on it, 束, which gave the sound but is read shù. It means walking fast. It means quick, speed.

phrase.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē de sùdù hěn kuài.
